description: This Java source file defines the MetricsFactory class, responsible for creating, retrieving, and managing Metrics instances within the OFBiz framework. It provides methods to instantiate metrics based on XML elements or explicitly specified parameters, and maintains a cache of these metrics. It also contains inner classes for the concrete Metrics implementation and a NullMetrics placeholder.

classes.name: MetricsImpl
classes.description: A private inner class implementing the Metrics interface, providing functionality such as recording service rate, calculation of metrics, reset, and comparison based on the metric name.

classes.name: NullMetrics
classes.description: A private inner class implementing the Metrics interface with no operational logic, representing a do-nothing Metrics object.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a Metrics instance based on XML element attributes, parsing configuration properties and attributes to initialize metrics parameters.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a Metrics instance based on explicit parameters such as name, estimation size/time, smoothing, and threshold.

methods.name: getMetric
methods.description: Retrieves an existing Metrics instance by name, or null if none exists.

methods.name: getMetrics
methods.description: Returns a collection of all Metrics instances, sorted by name.
